intro_q: You want to attend a campus club fair but are unsure about the location and schedule. Write an email to the student activities office.
tips: Type and speak at the same time to reduce the number of typos!
bullet1_q: Ask for details about the time and location of the club fair.
bullet2_q: Explain why you are interested in attending the event.
bullet3_q: Request recommendations for clubs you should visit.
